articles.title: C-DAC and Bank of India Partner to Advance Quantum Banking
articles.summary: India’s Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) and Bank of India (BOI) have signed an agreement to explore quantum technologies and other emerging digital tools for banking applications. The memorandum of understanding, signed on October 22, establishes a framework for joint research, technology demonstrations, proof-of-concept projects and capacity-building initiatives.

articles.title: India rewrite Asian Para Games record, but not every sport keeps pace
articles.summary: India finished the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya with a record 114 medals, surpassing the country's previous best at the continental event. The final tally of 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals bettered India's 2023 performance in Hangzhou, when the contingent officially finished with 108 medals after three medals were later stripped following doping violations.

articles.title: Mohanlal fans react to Vijay's 'I'm the Complete Actor' quip on KWK
articles.summary: Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s appearance on Koffee With Karan has sparked an online debate after their reaction to learning that Malayalam superstar Mohanlal is popularly known as the ‘Complete Actor’. The couple’s apparent surprise at the title has caught the attention of Mohanlal’s fans, with some questioning their unfamiliarity with the sobriquet associated with the veteran actor.

articles.title: Why The India-China Border Dispute Over Arunachal Pradesh Remains Unresolved
articles.summary: India regards Arunachal Pradesh as an integral part of the country, while China calls the region “Zangnan”, or South Tibet, and rejects what it describes as India’s establishment of the state. Beijing said in August that India’s naming exercise was “illegal, null and void” and would not change its claim to the territory.

articles.title: After working at Google, Accenture, P&G, IIT Patna graduate compares corporate jobs
articles.summary: For some, it offers an opportunity to explore their creativity beyond the structure of a conventional workplace. Shristi Shreya Singh, an IIT Patna graduate who has worked at Google, Procter & Gamble (P&G), Accenture Strategy and other organisations, has shared her experience of working across companies and building a presence as a content creator.

articles.title: Asian Para Games: India surpass 2022 tally, set new record with 114 medals, 30
articles.summary: India had sent a 168-member contingent to the Games, nearly half the size of the team that competed in Hangzhou in 2023. The Indian team had returned from that edition with 108 medals, including 27 gold, but raised the bar in Nagoya with 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals.

articles.title: Punjab News:Vote-Chori’ Is Serious Threat To Democracy; SIR Must Be Scrapped: CM Bhagwant
articles.summary: During discussion on motion to protect citizen’s voting rights under ongoing SIR, CM Bhagwant Singh Mann said Punjab had taken the lead in the country by passing a resolution condemning the SIR exercise and stressed that every eligible citizen must be able to exercise the right to vote without fear of arbitrary exclusion.

articles.title: STFE Prog to nurture young entrepreneurs in Nagaland
articles.summary: Kohima, October (MExN): The two-day Seed the Future Entrepreneur (STFE) Programme training commenced in Nagaland on October 23. Organised and funded by Dassault Systèmes La Fondation, with support from the Atal Innovation Mission (AIM), NITI Aayog, the national-level initiative is being implemented in Nagaland by Lend A Hand India (LAHI), in partnership with Samagra Shiksha Nagaland, Department of School Education.

articles.title: Himachal Government Issues 5% DA Hike Order, Employees to Get Increased Allowance
articles.summary: Sukhu announces ₹10,000 arrears for Class-IV employees and ₹10,000 payment for pensioners; state’s total debt stands at ₹99,564 crore Shimla : The Himachal Pradesh government has issued an order increasing the Dearness Allowance (DA) of state government employees and officers by five percentage points, raising it from 45 per cent to 50 per cent.
articles.title_hi: हिमाचल सरकार ने 5% डीए बढ़ोतरी का आदेश जारी किया, कर्मचारियों को बढ़ा हुआ भत्ता मिलेगा

I try to keep the focus on my own preparation rather than on what people are expecting from me. Expectations are natural when you have performed well in the past, but they cannot be allowed to become a distraction.

articles.title: India’s top financial regulators meet under Sitharaman to discuss stability
articles.summary: The FSDC is the government’s apex-level forum for coordinating work on financial stability, financial sector development and cooperation among regulators. Its mandate also covers financial literacy, financial inclusion and macroprudential supervision, including oversight of large financial conglomerates. The council and its subcommittee, chaired by the RBI Governor, discuss issues raised by members and recommend measures where necessary, according to ANI.

articles.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts. Updated daily
articles.summary: Gas prices in the United States, up by more than 40% since the U. S. and Israel launched the war, have soared as the global oil supply constricts . Now at a national average of more than $4 per gallon, according to data from motor club AAA , this price increase is straining already-stretched budgets in households across the country.

articles.title: C-DAC, Bank of India join hands to develop indigenous quantum technologies for banking
articles.summary: The collaboration will combine C-DAC 's expertise in high-performance computing, artificial intelligence (AI), quantum technologies, blockchain and cybersecurity with Bank of India's banking expertise and technology infrastructure. A key focus will be the development of a Quantum Ecosystem for Financial Innovation, aimed at preparing banking systems for opportunities and security challenges arising from quantum technologies.

articles.title: Sheikh Theyab holds talks with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi
articles.summary: Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed , deputy chairman of the Presidential Court for Development and Fallen Heroes’ Affairs, held talks on Friday with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi. Sheikh Theyab and Mr Modi explored ways to expand deep-rooted bilateral ties within the framework of the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in place between the nations.

articles.title: Mumbai Police seals hotel room linked to Tiger Shroff firing case suspects
articles.summary: The Mumbai Crime Branch has sealed an Andheri hotel room where three key suspects in the Tiger Shroff firing case allegedly stayed during the ongoing investigation. Authorities secured the location to gather evidence as part of the active probe into the incident, helping law enforcement trace the movements of the accused individuals involved in the case.

articles.title: India's forex reserves decline $5 billion to $721 billion: RBI data
articles.summary: India's forex reserves dropped by $5. 011 billion to $721. 016 billion during the week ended October 16, the Reserve Bank of India said on Friday. In the previous reporting week, the kitty declined by $8. 578 billion to $726. 027 billion. The reserves touched an all-time high of $785.

articles.title: Cockroach Janata Party Activists Face Delhi Court Hearing Over Protest
articles.summary: Cockroach Janata Party activists Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka, and Ajinkya Shinde face a Special Executive Magistrate court hearing on Friday. The Delhi Police Crime Branch continues its active investigation into the October 13 Jantar Mantar protest case after the activists previously skipped police questioning. This development marks a significant step forward in the ongoing legal proceedings.

articles.title: Marco Rubio says United States visa rules are global, not targeting India
articles.summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated during an India visit that recent work visa and green card program suspensions are global measures prioritizing American workers. articles.title: Kolkata Durga idol immersion delayed after stampede claims nineteen lives
articles.summary: A Durga idol at Chorbagan in Kolkata remains unimmersed following a fatal stampede during Saptami that claimed nineteen lives. The local pandal has turned into a crime scene, leaving the revered structure standing alone days after drawing large crowds of devotees. Authorities have delayed the immersion process while investigations into the tragic incident continue at the site.

articles.title: Only ‘Sanatanis’ Can Touch Durga Idols At Immersion Ghats: Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari
articles.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari on Wednesday said that only those who believe in ‘Sanatan Dharma’ would be allowed to touch Durga idols during immersion. He made the remarks while reviewing security arrangements at Baje Kadamtala Ghat, dismissing allegations that the directive had a communal motive and saying it was intended to preserve the sanctity of immersion rituals.

articles.title: Asian Para Games: Sandeep, Haney clinch gold with world records for India
articles.summary: India's Sandeep and Haney won gold medals with world record performances in the men's 400m T64 and men's javelin throw F37/38 events respectively at the Asian Para Games here on Friday. articles.title: ITBP chief says China face-offs ongoing along Arunachal, Congress attacks PM
articles.summary: It marks the first official confirmation of ongoing face-offs on the north-eastern border in Arunachal, where the situation has grown increasingly tense in recent months. ITBP Director General Shatrujeet Kapur said the face-offs have been ongoing since July, when reports emerged that Chinese troops were denying Indian forces access to key patrolling points along the LAC in the Taksing area.
articles.title_hi: आईटीबीपी प्रमुख का कहना है कि अरुणाचल में चीन के साथ आमना-सामना जारी है, कांग्रेस ने पीएम पर हमला बोला
articles.summary_hi: यह अरुणाचल में उत्तर-पूर्वी सीमा पर चल रहे टकराव की पहली आधिकारिक पुष्टि है, जहां हाल के महीनों में स्थिति तेजी से तनावपूर्ण हो गई है। आईटीबीपी के महानिदेशक शत्रुजीत कपूर ने कहा कि जुलाई से आमना-सामना जारी है, जब रिपोर्टें सामने आईं कि चीनी सैनिक भारतीय बलों को ताकसिंग क्षेत्र में एलएसी के साथ प्रमुख गश्त बिंदुओं तक पहुंचने से रोक रहे थे।
articles.title_hinglish: aaeetibipi pramukha ka kahana hai ki arunachala men china ke satha aamana-samana jari hai, kangresa ne piema para hamala bola
articles.summary_hinglish: yaha arunachala men uttara-purvi sima para chala rahe takarava ki pahali aadhikarika pushti hai, jahan hala ke mahinon men sthiti teji se tanavapurna ho gaee hai। aaeetibipi ke mahanideshaka shatrujita kapura ne kaha ki julaee se aamana-samana jari hai, jaba riporten samane aaeen ki chini sainika bharatiya balon ko takasinga kshetra men elaesi ke satha pramukha gashta binduon taka pahunchane se roka rahe the।

articles.title: Face-offs with China continuing along Arunachal border, says ITBP chief
articles.summary: The ITBP chief, however, said the force's Shaurya commandos performed "exceptionally well" during the confrontations. "Our newly raised Shaurya commandos played an exemplary role in this," he said. The Shaurya commandos specialise in high-altitude warfare. The ITBP, raised in 1962, guards the 3,488-km-long Line of Actual Control (LAC) with China.
articles.title_hi: आईटीबीपी प्रमुख का कहना है कि अरुणाचल सीमा पर चीन के साथ आमना-सामना जारी है
articles.summary_hi: हालांकि, आईटीबीपी प्रमुख ने कहा कि बल के शौर्य कमांडो ने टकराव के दौरान "असाधारण अच्छा" प्रदर्शन किया। उन्होंने कहा, "हमारे नवगठित शौर्य कमांडो ने इसमें अनुकरणीय भूमिका निभाई।" शौर्य कमांडो ऊंचाई पर युद्ध करने में माहिर हैं। 1962 में गठित आईटीबीपी चीन के साथ 3,488 किलोमीटर लंबी वास्तविक नियंत्रण रेखा (एलएसी) की रक्षा करती है।
articles.title_hinglish: aaeetibipi pramukha ka kahana hai ki arunachala sima para china ke satha aamana-samana jari hai
articles.summary_hinglish: halanki, aaeetibipi pramukha ne kaha ki bala ke shaurya kamando ne takarava ke daurana "asadharana achchha" pradarshana kiya। unhonne kah, "hamare navagathita shaurya kamando ne isamen anukaraniya bhumika nibhaee।" shaurya kamando oonchaee para yuddha karane men mahira hain। 1962 men gathita aaeetibipi china ke satha 3,488 kilomitara lanbi vastavika niyantrana rekha (elaesi) ki raksha karati hai।

articles.title: Punjab Pharmacy Council Cancels Registration Of Pharmacist Accused In Jhota Murder Case
articles.summary: The Punjab Pharmacy Council has cancelled the registration of pharmacist Ashwani Kumar, who is accused in the murder case of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota. According to an official order issued on October 22, 2026, the council’s Executive Committee decided to cancel Kumar’s registration during a meeting held on October 20.

articles.title: Puducherry co-op bank faces RBI curbs, withdrawals capped at Rs 5,000
articles.summary: PUDUCHERRY: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has imposed a cap on withdrawals at Rs 5,000 per customer at the Puducherry Co-operative Urban Bank Limited, apart from other restrictions, citing the bank’s liquidity position and failure to address supervisory concerns. articles.title: Trump declares wind turbine imports as threat to national security; India among top
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump recently declared that imports of wind turbines pose a threat to national security. The declaration followed a Commerce Department investigation focusing on cybersecurity issues related to foreign-made equipment. Trump cited concerns regarding foreign reliance and interruptions to radar systems and air traffic operations. Instead of imposing immediate tariffs, he directed trade officials to negotiate with partners.

articles.title: Only ‘sanatanis’ will touch idols during immersion: West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari
articles.summary: Only those who believe in ‘sanatan dharma’ will be allowed to touch Durga idols during immersion, chief minister Suvendu Adhikari said on Wednesday while inspecting security arrangements at Baje Kadamtala Ghat.
